Comments:
-Layout (8/10): The overall structure is highly similar: centered chessboard, top player/status bar, wide side margins, and “Remove ads” links in matching locations. The generated board is more compact vertically and uses square cells, while the reference board is noticeably taller; some header spacing and alignment also differ.
-Elements (12/15): Nearly all major elements are present, including the chessboard, pieces, player names, timers, score indicators, flags, badges, avatar icons, and side advertisements. A few icons and avatar details are rendered differently or positioned slightly differently.
-Content and Text (36/40): The chess position, board labels, player names, scores, timers, and advertising text are largely reproduced correctly. Minor discrepancies include capitalization/placement of “ROXY/Roxy,” differences in small header labels, and slight variations in icon-associated text.
-Style (9/15): The color palette and general visual treatment are close, especially the turquoise/green board and light gray page background. However, the chess piece set is substantially different: the reference uses large illustrated black-and-white pieces, while the generated version uses thinner outlined/icon-like pieces. The player avatars and small header graphics also differ stylistically.
-Overall (16/20): This is a strong structural and semantic match with the same game state and page composition. The main loss comes from the mismatched chess-piece artwork, altered board proportions, and differences in the header iconography.

Score: 81/100
